rules.rule: A search result, title or vendor snippet is only a discovery hint; a claim needs a fetched official source with its own excerpt and scope.
rules.limit: Tests establish the contract, not current end-to-end claim precision.

rules.rule: An unstated programme, intake, population or year dimension does not silently become a match; UNKNOWN or review remains possible.
rules.limit: The signed 2026-09-20 capture predates these changes. Re-measure end-to-end wrong-scope claims.

rules.rule: A navigation hop supplies additive coverage; treating unordered navigation links as an equal ranked generator displaced correct search results.
rules.limit: The 10/10 candidate-set ceiling was measured on ten development universities in a changing external index. It does not prove fetching or correct claims.

rules.rule: A host in verified registry seeds contributes a positive ranking signal, never a hard acceptance or rejection.
rules.limit: Toronto improved from rank 19 to 4 in the dated probe, while KAIST remained around rank 30 because its department host was not a seed. Repeat paired and held-out measurements before changing weights.
